name: Axis-Aligned Clipping
aliases: Clipping Planes for Planar Regions Outside Volume
definition: Hides portions of a 3D scene by defining up to six axis-aligned clipping planes (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax) to expose interior geometry.
summary: Axis-Aligned Clipping hides 3D scene portions using up to six planes restricted to coordinate axes, simplifying intersection logic compared to general plane clipping.
